COMMUNICATION
/1-6: Shortcut for using channels F1-F6. /AFK: Toggles "Away From Keyboard" status. Places parentheses around your name while AFK. /AFK (TEXT): Displays the text to players who send you a private message. /AMMO: To request ammunition. Other players will be notified of your request. /FRIENDS: Lists all players on your Friends list. /FRIEND (PLAYER): Adds or removes a player from your Friends list. /IGNORE (PLAYER): Adds or removes player from your Ignore list. You will not received messages from ignored players. (Also .IG). /M (PLAYER) (TEXT): Sends a private message to a specified player. /NOECHAT: Toggle receipt of enemy area chat on/off. /R (TEXT): Replies to the sender of the last Private Message received. /WHISPER (TEXT): Sends text on local channel, but only for short distance. (also .WHI, .W). /YELL (TEXT): Send text on local channel for greater distances. (Also .YE, .Y).
ACTION COMMANDS
CTRL+1: You yell, "Double Time!" CTRL+2: You yell,, "Take Cover!" CTRL+3: You yell "Stop!" CTRL+4: You yell, "Move Out!" CTRL+5: You yell, "More Ammo!" and request ammunition from other players.
EMOTES
/EM ATTENTION: Your persona comes to attention. /EM SALUTE: Your persona will come to attention and salute /EM CHEER: You start celebrating something /EM DOUBLE: You yell, "Double Time". /EM GYRUS: You surrender. /EM LAUGH: You laugh. /EM JUMP: You shout, "JUMP, JUMP, JUMP!!!"
